def check_sequence(g1, g2, g3, length=2025):
    g = [0] * (length + 1)
    g[1] = g1
    g[2] = g2
    g[3] = g3
    
    # g(1) + g(2) = g(3)g(4) - 840
    # g(4) = (g(1) + g(2) + 840) / g(3)
    if (g[1] + g[2] + 840) % g[3] != 0:
        return None
    g[4] = (g[1] + g[2] + 840) // g[3]
    if g[4] <= 1: return None
    
    for n in range(2, length - 2):
        # g(n) + g(n+1) = g(n+2)g(n+3) - 840
        if (g[n] + g[n+1] + 840) % g[n+2] != 0:
            return None
        g[n+3] = (g[n] + g[n+1] + 840) // g[n+2]
        if g[n+3] <= 1: return None
        # To avoid infinite growth or very large numbers, though unlikely here
        if g[n+3] > 2000: return None
        
    return sum(g[1:])

results = set()

    for g2 in special:
        for g3 in special:
            s = check_sequence(g1, g2, g3)
